changelog: V21.0.10: Added Park Walk — All-Weather Scene Guide with 40 detailed scenes and A6000 + 50mm F1.8 presets for sun, shade, backlight, overcast, rain, motion, blue hour and night.
V21.0.9: Corrected Photo Field Case grid structure so every case button, including sunset, plant, waterfront, passport and wedding, appears inside the searchable grid.

V21.0.8: Repaired four nested photo Field Cases so they open and return correctly; hardened navigation against missing or nested cards; expanded sunset reflections and added bilingual Wedding Guest presets.
V21.0.7: Self-healing update UI recreates Check Update and update notice elements when an older cached index.html lacks them; bumps cache version to recover affected installs.
V21.0.6: Added bilingual Sunset — Color, Silhouette & Foreground Photo Field Case with sunset color, silhouette, layered lifestyle and blue-hour presets.
V21.0.5: Added bilingual Backlit Ornamental Plant — Leaf Glow photo field case with four exposure presets, composition, focus, highlight control and accessory guidance.
V21.0.4: Fixed missing update-control elements that stopped pwa.js before service-worker registration; added visible Check Update UI and a one-time service-worker recovery activation.
V21.0.3: Added a bilingual Waterfront Café — Golden Hour photo field case with four compositions and Sony A6000 + 50mm F1.8 exposure presets.

V21.0.2: Added a bilingual Passport Photo 4×6 cm field case for Sony A6000 + 50mm F1.8, including setup, lighting, pose, exposure, crop, print/export and official Vietnamese passport-photo requirements.
V21.0.1: Added bilingual Sony A6000 in-camera Hanoi Morning Film JPEG recipe to the Morning Warm Sun photo case, with Creative Style, WB shift, exposure guidance and safe MR-slot saving.
V21: searchable bilingual catalog, light/subject/purpose filters, field workflows, saved photo and video preflight, version display and user-controlled updates.
Separated styling, application logic and video case data; added release validation, service worker regression checks and deployment artifact staging.
Roadmap Phase 1: dedicated Photo OS Start Here layer.
Added MR1/MR2/MR3 base chooser and Photo quick-decision matrix.
Added Photo Control Ladder for movement, aperture, shutter, ISO, EV, focus and WB.
Added Photo Quick Rules and one-variable-at-a-time debugging guidance.
No new Field Case added in V19; Photo and Video Field Case Libraries remain separate.
Prevented the service worker from caching browser extension and out-of-scope requests.
Activated the GitHub Pages deployment workflow so updates on main publish to the project site.
Fixed GitHub Pages project-site paths for the manifest, icons, service worker, and update checks.
Added Photo Field Case: Morning Warm Sun — Tree-Lined Road with sky + trees + road composition workflow.
Added Photo Field Cases: Sun Through Trees and Morning Walker — Human Scale.
Added Video Field Cases: Morning Warm Sun — Cinematic Road, Sun Through Canopy — Slow Pan, and Morning Walker — Human Scale B-roll.
Kept Photo and Video Field Case Libraries separate with concise cards and detailed case actions.
